expanded_changes: Group the Shabbat Yotzer alternative under one bilingual condition rubric, with a matching local declaration.
Declare shabbat=false inside the weekday Yotzer group.
Use the existing frankfurt_am_main rite key for the Frankfurt Bameh Madlikin inclusion.
fixes.documentary_instruction_policy: Keep the printed continuation rubric in documentary El Adon. Local declarations settle its nested condition in expanded output, avoiding mid-verse navigation without deleting documentary evidence.

decisions.finding: Delete documentary El Adon continuation rubric
decisions.disposition: Preserve its actual source wording and original page location in documentary. Outer shared expanded Shabbat group declares shabbat=true, which settles and hides the nested source routing rubric even when the outer day is unspecified. Actual compiler checks verify no el_adon_segment_2 conditional survives. This fixes expanded presentation without deleting source evidence.

decisions.finding: Verse unit must use Bible namespace
decisions.disposition: No change. Existing importer convention and tests explicitly permit occurrence-context verse milestones when a canonical quotation was already mapped elsewhere. See test_repeated_scripture_has_addressable_chapter_and_verse_context in importer tests and existing context registry. Both languages use identical unit and correspondence; canonical Bible reference stays in bounded seg/source. Existing approved source/group reviews already documented this convention.
Canonical mapping unique in each documentary project; verified by XPath. Keep the existing identity.
Keep established chapter-context/terminator authoring convention. No source or alignment bug demonstrated.

Use frankfurt_am_main consistently in expanded Bameh Madlikin, matching existing later Frankfurt rules. Actual compiler check confirms weekday Frankfurt includes Bameh while weekday non-Frankfurt omits it.
